reviews.reason: ANA provides authoritative coordinates for a used well on an Explomin operational property described as warehouse-related, but the evidence identifies Mz. B Lote 1. Nexo's legacy reference Site is based on Mz. B Lote 2, while the separately discovered headquarters is described as Panamericana Sur Km. 22 Huertos de Conchán. The coordinate is authoritative for the feature, but the Site-to-coordinate association is not yet unambiguous.
